**OpenSpec change:** `openspec/changes/<id>`
**Slice:** <number or name of the slice>

## What we do

1–3 sentences in plain words: what appears, and why the user needs it.

## Scenarios

From the spec deltas. The details are in the change.

- [ ] <scenario 1>
- [ ] <scenario 2>

## Done when

- [ ] All scenarios pass, and each has a test or a check
- [ ] Review in a fresh context is done
- [ ] Documents are updated. A lesson in `docs/learning/lessons/` for each problem that had a real choice
